payout_quote: For a limited time, you can earn $300* when you open a new Star Rewards Checking Account and use promo code 300.
steps: Open a new Star Rewards Checking Account between 9/1/2026 and 11/30/2026 using promo code 300
Receive qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 within 60 days of account opening
Complete 12 debit card transactions within 60 days of account opening
$300 is deposited directly into the new checking account once all requirements are met (account in good standing)
catches: Not available to existing Town & Country checking members or anyone whose Town & Country checking account was closed within the previous 18 months

Bonus value may be reported as taxable income on IRS Form 1099
Limited-time offer; account must be opened by 11/30/2026 and terms are subject to change
